result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with no stock. The full offline suite passes (607 tests, 0 failures).

The change is a one-line fix in `DataStore.listStockByWarehouse` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java:1490`). The query gets the same `s.quantity > 0` filter the other stock overviews use. The single-product lookup (`findStockQuantity`, used by `StockService.getQuantity`) is a separate query and is untouched, so asking for the nuts in WH-1 still returns 0.

I did not add a regression test for the WH-1 example. Nothing is committed.
